description: A suite of GTM skills built on Browse Engagements + Conversation Intelligence (with Account/Contact Research as supporting context).

features.description: ENHANCE meeting-prep: add a browse_engagements upcoming-meeting picker (when no account/attendee is named) and conversation_intelligence prior-conversation synthesis (open threads, unresolved questions, suggested asks) layered onto the existing brief.
steps: Add a meeting-selection path: when no account/attendee is supplied, call browse_engagements (forward window) and present a numbered shortlist to pick from
After resolving the account, add a CI synthesis step (company- or engagement-scoped) for prior conversation context: open threads, unresolved questions, suggested asks
Fold CI output into TL;DR and a new 'Prior conversations' section without bloating the 30-min brief
Add Prerequisites note (integrations required; AI credits) and graceful no-data fallback

features.description: NEW engagement-timeline: pure browse_engagements timeline. Default 90-day look-back, sliding window for further back. List participants with per-participant engagement counts, engagements by type, and pull engagement IDs into context (not shown) so the user can double-click any one via CI.
steps: Resolve scope (account/contact/user) and date window (default 90d; sliding window when user asks to look further back)
Call browse_engagements with the right scope/sort/limit; handle the 90-day max window by paging the window backward when needed
Render a timeline: engagements by type, participants with counts; keep engagement IDs in context, not in user-facing output
Offer to double-click any engagement via conversation_intelligence; add Prerequisites note + no-data fallback

features.description: NEW call-recap: browse_engagements (recent) proposes a selection, user picks one or more; conversation_intelligence + account_research produce a compact recap (summary, decisions, action items, open questions). Template adjusts to the query.
steps: If no call named, call browse_engagements (-chronological, MEETINGS) and present a numbered shortlist of recent calls
On selection, run conversation_intelligence scoped to the engagement ID(s); pull account_research for light context
Render a compact high-signal recap template (summary, decisions, action items, open questions), adjustable to the user query
Prerequisites note + graceful fallback

features.description: NEW daily-brief: browse_engagements for today's meetings, then parallel account_research, contact_research, and conversation_intelligence per meeting to produce state of play, a suggested focus/objective for each, and follow-ups needed.
steps: Call browse_engagements for today's (or the named day's) meetings
Per meeting, fan out account_research / contact_research / CI in parallel (mind AI credits; cap breadth)
Render one compact card per meeting: state of play, suggested focus/objective, follow-ups needed
Prerequisites + credit note + fallback when no meetings

features.description: NEW account-relationship-recap: account_research + conversation_intelligence (company-scoped) recapping recent engagements with emphasis on how the relationship is evolving.
steps: Resolve company (ID or search_companies)
Run account_research + company-scoped CI for recent-conversation themes and trajectory
Render where-we-stand recap emphasizing relationship evolution (warming/cooling, new stakeholders, shifts)
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW contact-relationship-recap: contact-scoped conversation_intelligence (+ account_research) for where we stand with a person across recent conversations, emphasis on relationship evolution.
steps: Resolve contact (ID or search_contacts)
Run contact-scoped CI + contact_research for this person's recent conversation history and posture
Render where-we-stand-with-this-person recap emphasizing relationship evolution
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW draft-follow-up: conversation_intelligence extracts commitments and next steps from a call, then drafts a compact, friendly-professional follow-up email.
steps: Resolve the engagement (named, or browse_engagements recent picker)
Run CI to extract commitments, next steps, and key points
Draft a concise, warm-but-professional follow-up email; pause to confirm tone/recipient if ambiguous
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW commitment-ledger: conversation_intelligence-primary. What we promised vs what they promised, and what is still outstanding across the last few engagements.
steps: Resolve scope (account or contact; or a picked engagement set)
Run CI to extract commitments by side (us vs them) and status
Render a two-column ledger with outstanding items flagged; note CI only sees the last few engagements
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW next-best-action: conversation_intelligence-primary. Given conversation state, recommend the next move, grounded in what was actually said.
steps: Resolve scope (account/contact/engagement)
Run CI to read current conversation state (open threads, signals, blockers)
Recommend 1-3 concrete next actions tied to specific evidence; no generic advice without support
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW objection-blocker-tracker: conversation_intelligence across recent calls; surface open objections and how they have evolved.
steps: Resolve account/contact scope
Run CI to surface objections and blockers across recent engagements and their trajectory
Render open objections with status (raised/addressed/recurring); note the last-few-engagements limit
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW decision-process-mapper: conversation_intelligence; map the prospect's stated buying process, criteria, timeline, and approvers as voiced on recent calls.
steps: Resolve account scope
Run CI to extract stated process, decision criteria, timeline, and named approvers
Render a decision-process map; mark gaps as 'not stated' rather than inferring
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW call-coaching: browse_engagements to pick the likely call if unspecified; conversation_intelligence; coach discovery/objection handling (what went well, what to improve, focus for the next call).
steps: If no call named, use browse_engagements to identify the most likely recent call and confirm with the user
Run CI scoped to that engagement; analyze discovery quality and objection handling against best practice
Render coaching: what went well, what to improve, focus areas for the next call; cite moments
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW account-health: browse_engagements timeline + conversation_intelligence (sentiment/risk) + account_research snapshot. Evidence-only; ask the user before asserting unsupported claims.
steps: Build a recent timeline via browse_engagements; run CI for sentiment trajectory and risk signals; pull account_research snapshot
Synthesize a health read with explicit evidence per claim
Where evidence is thin, ask the user for input rather than generating generic advice
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW renewal-prep: conversation_intelligence value moments + risk handles + account_research. Evidence-only; do not assume the renewal date if not provided (ask the user).
steps: Resolve account; if renewal date/terms not provided, ask the user rather than assuming
Run CI for value moments and risk handles; pull account_research for deal/relationship context
Render pre-renewal context: value delivered, risks, handles; flag unverified assumptions
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW ae-cs-handoff: browse_engagements timeline + parallel conversation_intelligence on key engagements to capture requirements/objectives, relationship, stakeholders, and how they like to work.
steps: Build the engagement timeline; identify the key engagements
Run CI in parallel on those engagements to pull requirements, objectives, stakeholders, working style, relationship state
Render a CSM-ready handoff brief
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW exec-brief: account_research + conversation_intelligence + contact_research into a succinct one-pager for an exec dropping into a call cold.
steps: Resolve account and (if known) the key attendee(s)
Run account_research + CI + contact_research; keep it tight
Render a one-page exec brief: who/what/why-now, relationship, the ask, landmines
Prerequisites + fallback

features.description: NEW email-thread-summarizer: browse_engagements (EMAILS) to find threads, then conversation_intelligence with includeContent to fetch bodies. Output summary, current state, open questions.
steps: Use browse_engagements (EMAILS) to find the relevant thread(s); present a picker if ambiguous
Run CI with includeContent on the chosen engagement to fetch the email body/thread
Render summary, current state, and open questions
Prerequisites + fallback
